how: We read the website of every Austin wedding DJ listed on Lazo (26 listings, 20 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: multi-service franchises, a city park pavilion, a downtown rooftop venue, a talent roster page and a DJ site with no readable text. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
How do you handle ceremony audio and toasts outdoors in the Hill Country, and do you bring backup power for a ranch venue?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, photo booth and extra hours on top?

picks.name: Sunkisst Entertainment DJ & Photo Booth
picks.blurb: Jared and Desiree are the husband-and-wife team behind Sunkisst Entertainment in Round Rock, bringing DJ and photo booth service to Central Texas dance floors. The site prints DJ prices starting at $695, with no extra charge for set-up or tear-down and a clean booth with your choice of scrim.

picks.name: Full Scope Entertainment
picks.blurb: Steven Scott Slyter started DJing after four years in the U.S. military, left his corporate job and founded Full Scope Entertainment in 2017. The Austin company does wedding DJ, photography and photo booths across Central Texas and says it was particular about who it hired.

picks.name: Austin Pix N' Party
picks.blurb: Chris of Austin Pix N' Party was born and raised in Austin and has a DJ career spanning 24 years that began with electronic music at high school parties. The Kyle company pairs DJ services with photo booth rentals and a professional attendant for weddings, parties and corporate events.

picks.name: Cedar & Oak Entertainment and Events
picks.blurb: Cedar & Oak is a locally owned entertainment and events company working Austin, San Antonio and the surrounding areas, with DJ and MC packages, event infrastructure and music consultation. It says it loves weddings more than anything, and package pricing is on the site, roughly $1,400 to $3,900 at our read.

picks.name: Pharill Entertainment
picks.blurb: DJ Pharill, pronounced fa-rill, curates DJ and MC services for weddings and receptions alongside corporate and nightlife events in Austin. The pitch is an eclectic taste in music and style, and the ability to match the diverse range of sounds each kind of event calls for.

picks.name: Premier Entertainment
picks.blurb: Premier Entertainment is a group of audio and visual experts with nightlife roots who blend old and new, delivering DJ entertainment, live musicians, event lighting and photo booths in Austin. The site publishes its rates, including a $400 per hour DJ performance rate with a two-hour minimum for corporate events.

picks.name: Bat City Beats
picks.blurb: Bat City Beats promises to turn the classiest events into the wildest parties, with DJs it describes as artists who know how to read a crowd. Based in Leander, working weddings, corporate events and private parties, with couples' notes on the site naming Neema as the DJ.

picks.name: SPIN EVENTZ | DJ & Photo Booth Austin TX
picks.blurb: Spin Eventz offers bilingual DJ and MC services for weddings, corporate events and quinceaneras across Texas, from Austin and San Antonio to Dallas-Fort Worth and Houston. Your entertainment is personally planned and overseen by Andrés, with photo booth and karaoke available.

picks.name: Texas Professional Disc Jockey
picks.blurb: Texas Professional Disc Jockey has been doing wedding DJs in Austin since 1999, along with bar and bat mitzvahs and corporate parties. The site says it has been voted best DJs in Texas by The Knot, WeddingWire and Austin 360, and add-ons include lighting options and a Mirror Me photo booth.

picks.name: Austin's Best DJs & Photo Booths
picks.blurb: Austin's Best DJs & Photo Booths limits bookings to one event per day and says it has 14 years in Austin, with a client list that includes ACL, SXSW and Formula 1. You give the date, they check availability, and you are matched with the DJ that fits, with sound, lighting and photo booths from the same team.

picks.name: Tully Entertainment
picks.blurb: Most DJs bring a playlist; Tully Entertainment says it brings a host, who shows up in a suit, keeps the night on time, looks after your family and plays the right song at the right moment. Based in Lakeway, covering Austin, San Antonio and the Hill Country, with pricing shown up front on the site.

picks.name: ATX DJ
picks.blurb: Sean of ATX DJ has worked more than 1,000 weddings in Austin and builds every set around the crowd in front of him, no cookie-cutter sets. The site notes the 2026 calendar is almost full and that he is now reserving for 2027 and 2028, with photo booth service alongside the DJ.
